sub3041: First there was darkness.

This time there was a bird on my chest and
I tried to pet it but it flew away.
Then I was in a forest and there were mushrooms.
It was dark and
I decided to rest and wait until morning to explore.
However, when I laid down under a tree to sleep
I heard something.
At first I tried to ignore it because I thought I was being paranoid,
but then it became apparent it was real.
I decided to get up and run,
the sound of barking chasing me through the woods.
I came to a village, hoping to find a friend, and
began knocking on doors.
An old man opened the door of one of the houses and
I begged him to let me in because dogs were chasing me.
He was acting odd though and simply stepped aside to let me in without saying anything.
Once I came inside he raised his hand to his face, gasping.
He told me he recognized me as the missing heir to the Heart Kingdom throne.
I was supposed to have been in a magically induced slumber until I was old enough to rule.
I didn't believe him at first and
questioned how I could be a royal, but
then vague memories started to come back to me of my childhood.
I remembered some faces and names.
One of the names was Mary Ann.
The old man told me he was extremely passionate about the Royal family and knew a ton about us and
that is why he recognized me on first sight.
He offered me tea and bread with jam
after I complained about being hungry.
